author: tanloong
text:
I once ran into the same situation when automating a desktop application, and finally switched to using UI element properties for locating, something like this:
from pywinauto import WindowSpecification, mouse
from pywinauto.application import Application, ProcessNotFoundError

EXE_PATH = "/path/to/application.exe"
app = Application(backend="uia").connect(path=EXE_PATH)
main_window = app.window(title="<window title>")
child_window = main_window.child_window(class_name="<names>")
loc = child_window.rectangle()
coord = (loc.mid_point().x, loc.mid_point().y)
mouse.click(coord)

To get window titles, class names etc I used the Accessibility Insights for Windows.
